! Game text
| Deploy on table with {{Errata hl|1=up to 12}} Defensive Shields (that do not count against your deck limit) from outside your deck face-down under here. 4 times per game you may play a card from here as if from hand. While Yoda not on Dagobah, each ▲ or ▼ attempt (after the first in a turn) allows a player’s opponent to draw the top card of their Reserve Deck and/or activate 1 Force. || Deploy on table {{Errata hl|1=with 12 Defensive Shields}} from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless Yoda on Dagobah, each player’s ▲ or ▼ attempt (after the first in a turn) allows their opponent to draw top card from Reserve deck and/or activate 1 Force.
